answer: Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The nectar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
